verdict.rationale: An OS running well on older hardware is a fair question for Windows, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Windows giving better performance or longer device life on older machines. The nearby items don't qualify: app/accessory compatibility with Windows 10, the PC Health Check app, and the Windows 10 Extended Security Updates program are related features, not this capability. The Windows 11 Pro page also targets users with high-performance hardware needs.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get better performance and extended device lifespan by installing the OS on older hardware
